number of parameters: 4
fields:

        ContinuousOn.{0, 0} (fun θ => KN.Physics.radiativeValue b r θ (raw r θ) i) (Set.Icc.{0} 0 Real.pi)
  KN.Physics.PublishedPhysicalNecessaryData.charged : Ne.{1} b.Q 0 →
      ∃ plus minus phantom,
        KN.Physics.PublishedChiralSystem Bool.true b m omega plus.components ∧
          KN.Physics.PublishedChiralSystem Bool.false b m omega minus.components ∧
            KN.Physics.PhantomIdentification b raw phantom plus.components minus.components

      ∃ F,
        KN.Physics.KerrRadiativeNecessarySystem b m omega F ∧
          ∀ (i : KN.Physics.RadiativeComponent) (r : ℝ),
            LT.lt.{0} b.rPlus r →
              ContinuousOn.{0, 0} (fun θ => KN.Physics.radiativeValue b r θ (raw r θ) i) (Set.Ioo.{0} 0 Real.pi) ∧
                ↑↑(F i r) =ᵐ[KN.Kerr.sphericalMeasure] fun θ => KN.Physics.radiativeValue b r θ (raw r θ) i

              KN.Physics.PhantomIdentification b raw phantom plus.components minus.components)
    (kerr :
